method: Independent written algebra and scope review. Read repository instructions and current project context plus all three declared dependencies. No original code, simulation, fits, pickle, or history replay executed; no implementation or specification changed.

checks.reason: d_i^T c = z_i^T a-y_i and c^T(sum d_i d_i^T)c = sum r_i^2; rank deficiency and nonlinear a do not alter the identity. Conditional fixed-feature/data-adaptive and known-weight restrictions are explicit; prior ownership and joint boundary transport are separate.
Substituting a0+T phi yields T^T z and shifted y-z^T a0. D=S(a-a0)=U phi requires T=S^-1 U. Scalar S=2 witness correctly refutes S U. Sampled SVD is explicitly not a global rank certificate.

Free response error scales by incoming-state amplitude; bounded-support or tail control is required. Decay does not delete old cross moments. Unknown signed hysteresis rates, Q, amplitude and incoming state remain joint obligations.

Binomial expansion gives exactly the displayed d+1 q-power coefficients. For exp(x-cq), fixing x and differentiating in c produces the invertible distinct-q Vandermonde matrix, proving arbitrarily large fixed-linear-feature rank; known c gives separability. No unrestricted nonlinear-statistic necessity theorem is asserted.

Expansion gives r^T e+||e||^2/2. Entire-support potential bound implies both likelihood and normalizer ratios in [exp(-delta),exp(delta)], hence posterior density ratio in [exp(-2delta),exp(2delta)]. Same-prior/support and finite-normalizer premises suffice. Batch and replacement defects telescope/triangle-sum; rowwise bounds grow with N and do not certify derivatives or lifetime.

V second derivative is 1+3 epsilon theta^2. New reference objective is strictly convex with stationarity (1+K)theta+epsilon theta^3=KM. For fixed positive epsilon,K and M tending to positive infinity its minimizer is asymptotic to (KM/epsilon)^(1/3), versus linear KM/(1+K) for the archive. Small local Hessian variation cannot certify later global shifts. Bounded battery-domain qualification is explicit.

Packed binary64 root costs 8 W(W+1)/2=4760 bytes for W=34. Sixteen-dimensional root plus mean costs 1088+128=1216 bytes per component before weights/other fields. P3 named peak 8568 and generic-prior 9528 match cited dependency and retain its exclusions.

nonblocking_notes.requested_disposition: Describe this as scaling verification/requirement unless an explicit erroneous source is identified. No mathematical change is needed.

acceptance_scope: Accept only the stated conditional symbolic identities, sufficient constructions and counterexamples. No feasibility, physical accuracy, calibrated coverage, useful sustained inference, full-model approximation, cumulative floating-point or Cortex-M23 qualification is discharged.
